name: ScrollColorShift
description: Chapter sections inside a smooth-scroll viewport where the whole background and text color interpolate between up to four colors as each section reaches the center, with automatic light/dark text for contrast and a tunable blend window.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" ("Color sections") so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native) with a 2px :focus-visible outline in the current text color. Each chapter is a <section> with a real heading. textMode="auto" picks near-black or near-white text from the background's luminance so contrast holds at every section; the chapter counter and ring decorations are aria-hidden. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move and is released at the edges; touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and colors switch at the midpoint between sections instead of fading continuously.

propsApi.name: sections
propsApi.description: Section titles; the background shifts color between consecutive sections.

propsApi.name: color1
propsApi.description: Background of section 1 (colors repeat every 4 sections).

propsApi.name: textMode
propsApi.description: Text color; auto picks light or dark per background for contrast.

propsApi.name: blend
propsApi.description: Portion of the scroll between two section centers spent blending (0.1 quick swap, 1 continuous).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
